AVIATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.

2. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

4. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.

8. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.

11. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.

12. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

13. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

15. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
